TEXT: [FI] O Hero, death should not have taken thee...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] Unfortunately, your fated choice was misguided.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] But rest easy. For you who have been filled with 
suffering on this journey, we bestow our guidance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Seriously though, this time, no matter how you look 
at it, it's your fault! You have to be mindful that 
Ayase is new to Akiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT: [FI] "Learn from your own mistakes", is what they say...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] No, not at all... But I agree, I also felt that you 
weren't being considerate this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] First off, you have to read between the lines to find 
out the words Ayase can't say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] Though she looks confident, she's a girl who's 
younger than you. You have to take the lead.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] The crossroads of fate diverge innumerously, and 
there exist no two identical ends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] That said, if you look at it from another perspective, 
it means that "there are many other different 
outcomes".

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] If there's a future you desire, push onwards and 
never give up. That is the only way to traverse the 
road of fate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRIRIN
TEXT:
[FI] If you make Ayase cry next time, I won't let you 
off so easily!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONYAN
TEXT:
[FI] Have you carved our words into your heart? Then 
depart now, towards your desired conclusion.
